## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Black screen throughout. Center stage: first the white bookmark glyph, then a pill search field with a blinking cursor and cycling placeholder ("Search anything...", "Search illustration", "Search typography", "Search everything..."). Behind it, two to three vertical columns of vibrant content cards (portraits, 3D renders, typography posters) scroll upward.

## Motion spec
Pattern: logo-to-search morph over an awakening content stream.
- The bookmark pinches inward (scaleX 1 -> 0.1, 250ms, ease-in) becoming a thin cursor line, then the search pill expands around it (width 0 -> full, 350ms, spring ~260/18) with a soft glow halo.
- Card columns fade up from black and begin scrolling (each column a different speed, 30-50px/s, continuous loop).
- The placeholder text types out character by character (~60ms/char), holds 900ms, deletes (~30ms/char), and types the next hint.
- The search field stays fixed center; cards pass behind it at reduced opacity.

## Calibration
- The glow on the search field is the light source of the scene - cards nearest it catch a hint of it.
- Card columns scroll seamlessly with no visible wrap.

## Reduced motion
Logo crossfades to the search field (250ms); columns appear statically; placeholder swaps without typing.

## Don't miss
- The cursor from the morph becomes the search field's live cursor - one continuous element.
- Cards are cropped bold artwork, not thumbnails with chrome.
